title: Yieldingly Smoked Jamaican Cheese Tagine
description: Tangy, aromatic, and delightfully creamy, this Jamaican cheese tagine is a perfect date-night dish. Served in an agave leaf, it's a culinary experience like no other.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the jerk seasoning, allspice, thyme, and smoked paprika to make the spice blend.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat. Add the chopped scotch bonnet peppers and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add the ginger and sauté for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the feta cheese, honey, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring until the cheese is melted and well combined with the spice blend.
Spoon the cheese mixture onto the center of each agave leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the 2 sides of the agave leaf over the filling, then roll the leaf into a neat package and secure with kitchen twine.
Place the agave packages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the agave leaves are tender.
Remove the agave packages from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro. Serve immediately.
